title: Brazil chooses between Lula and Bolsonaro in nail-biter vote

article.title: Brazil chooses between Lula and Bolsonaro in nail-biter vote
article.summary: Brazil held its breath on Sunday as voters went to the polls to decide between leftist leader Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva or his right-wing challenger Flavio Bolsonaro. It is the final electoral battle for Lula, who turns 81 on Tuesday and is hoping to pull off a dramatic turnaround after coming in second to the son of former president Jair Bolsonaro in the first round of voting. Final polls showed the two candidates neck-and-neck. Sunday’s runoff will determine whether Brazil remains one of Latin America’s few leftist nations or joins a regional swing to the right championed by US President Donald Trump , an ally of the Bolsonaro family, though he has not openly endorsed Flavio. Lula, who is seeking a fourth non-consecutive term, has pitched himself as a bulwark against US interference and democratic backsliding and promised to expand social protections. The right “wants to govern with the American flag”, he said after casting his ballot in the state of Sao Paulo.
